missing_value_policy: NaN passed natively to the model; NEVER imputed
scaling: NONE - tree-based model requires no feature scaling

deployable_blocked_features.production_hours_msha_reference_only: US-manshift-derived MSHA reference value; no B' parameter resolved for Indian units
deployable_blocked_features.avg_penalty_amount: USD-denominated, MSHA regulatory-regime specific; no currency/regime conversion policy exists

deployable_blocked_policy: Both blocked features are forced to NaN unconditionally in deployable/Indian scoring mode, never accepted as a caller-supplied value and never imputed. The model itself is NOT retrained - it still expects all 9 MSHA-training columns; the blocked columns are nulled at inference time, not dropped.
